te: Frederick VI of Denmark cedes the Kingdom of Norway to Charles XIII of Sweden in return for Pomerania.
dz: 基尔条约:丹麦弗雷德里克六世将挪威王国割让给瑞典查理十三世以换取波美拉尼亚.
de: Treaty of Kiel: Frederick VI of Denmark cedes the Kingdom of Norway to Charles XIII of Sweden in return for Pomerania.

dz: 第六次反法同盟战争：法国在布赖恩战役中与俄罗斯和普鲁士交战。
de: War of the Sixth Coalition: France engages Russia and Prussia in the Battle of Brienne.

de: Gervasio Antonio de Posadas becomes Supreme Director of the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata (present-day Argentina).

dz: 菲律宾的马永火山爆发,造成约1200人死亡,这是火山最具破坏性的火山爆发.

te: The last of the River Thames frost fairs comes to an end.
dz: 泰晤士河最后的"霜花会"落幕.
de: The last of the River Thames frost fairs comes to an end.

te: The Battle of Champaubert ends in French victory over the Russians and the Prussians.
dz: 拿破仑战争：尚波贝尔战役以法国战胜俄国人和普鲁士人而告终。

dz: 第六次反法同盟战争：莫尔芒战役。
de: War of the Sixth Coalition: The Battle of Mormant.

te: The Battle of Montereau.
dz: 拿破仑战争：蒙特罗战役。

de: War of 1812: Americans defeat British forces at the Battle of Longwoods between London, Ontario and Thamesville, near present-day Wardsville, Ontario.

dz: 法国皇帝拿破仑一世在克劳恩战役中取胜.

te: Emperor Napoleon I is defeated at the Battle of Laon in France.
dz: 拿破仑皇帝 我在法国拉昂之战被打败了.
de: Emperor Napoleon I is defeated at the Battle of Laon in France.

t: 奥地利军队在奥布河畔阿尔西斯战役中击退法国军队。
te: Austrian forces repel French troops in the Battle of Arcis-sur-Aube.
dz: 拿破仑战争：奥地利军队在奥布河畔阿尔西斯战役中击退法国军队。
de: Napoleonic Wars: Austrian forces repel French troops in the Battle of Arcis-sur-Aube.

dz: 1812 年战争：在阿拉巴马州中部，安德鲁·杰克逊 (Andrew Jackson) 将军领导的美军在马蹄湾战役 (Battle of Horseshoe Bend) 中击败了克里克河。

t: 在瓦尔帕莱索战役中，两艘美国海军舰艇被两艘皇家海军舰艇俘获。
te: In the Battle of Valparaíso, two American naval vessels are captured by two Royal Navy vessels.
dz: 1812 年战争：在瓦尔帕莱索战役中，两艘美国海军舰艇被两艘皇家海军舰艇俘获。
de: War of 1812: In the Battle of Valparaíso, two American naval vessels are captured by two Royal Navy vessels.

dz: 拿破仑第一次（有条件）退位，并任命他的儿子拿破仑二世为法国皇帝，两天后无条件退位。
de: Napoleon abdicates (conditionally) for the first time and names his son Napoleon II as Emperor of the French, followed by unconditional abdication two days later.

te: Nominal beginning of the Bourbon Restoration; anniversary date that Napoleon abdicates and is exiled to Elba.
dz: 波旁恢复计划的名义开始;周年纪念日拿破仑退位并被放逐到埃尔巴.

dz: 威灵顿公爵手下的盟军进攻被马歇尔·苏尔特所牵制的图卢兹,在激烈战斗后赶走了法军.
de: Allied forces under the Duke of Wellington attack Toulouse held by Marshall Soult, driving out the French after fierce fighting.

t: 丰特涅布劳条约结束了第六联军对拿破仑·波拿巴的战争,并迫使他第一次无条件退位.

dz: 斐迪南七世国王废除了1812年西班牙宪法,使西班牙恢复了专制.
de: King Ferdinand VII abolishes the Spanish Constitution of 1812, returning Spain to absolutism.

dz: 拿破仑皇帝抵达厄尔巴岛的费拉约港，开始流放。

de: The Constitution of Norway is signed and Crown Prince Christian Frederick of Denmark is elected King of Norway by the Norwegian Constituent Assembly.

dz: 1812 年战争：美国军队从加拿大北部的英国军队手中夺取了伊利堡。

dz: 瑞典-挪威战争开始.

dz: 伦敦公约是英国和荷兰之间的一项条约,在英国伦敦签署.

dz: 1812 年战争：在围攻伊利堡期间，英国军队对美国守军发起了一次代价高昂且不成功的夜间袭击。
de: War of 1812: British forces launch a costly and unsuccessful night attack against American defenders during the siege of Fort Erie.

dz: 北点战役:一支美国分遣队在1812年战争中阻止了向巴尔的摩推进的英地.

te: In a turning point in the War of 1812, the British fail to capture Baltimore. During the battle, Francis Scott Key comp…
dz: 在1812年战争的转折点中,英国人未能攻克巴尔的摩. 在战斗中,弗朗西斯·斯科特·克特(Francis Scott Key)作诗"保卫麦克亨利要塞"(Defence of Fort McHenry),这首诗后来被设定为音乐并成为美国的国歌.
de: In a turning point in the War of 1812, the British fail to capture Baltimore. During the battle, Francis Scott Key composes his poem "Defence of Fort McHenry", which is later set to music and becomes the United States' national anthem.

dz: 1812 年战争：美国海军卡罗莱纳号纵帆船的毁灭结束了海军准将丹尼尔·帕特森的临时舰队，该舰队进行了一系列拖延行动，为安德鲁·杰克逊在新奥尔良战役中取得胜利做出了贡献。
de: War of 1812: The destruction of the schooner USS Carolina brings to an end Commodore Daniel Patterson's makeshift fleet, which fought a series of delaying actions that contributed to Andrew Jackson's victory at the Battle of New Orleans.
